source_user: Advanced cluster case GDS-95: Evaluate GPUDirect Storage for checkpoint and dataset I/O in distributed training. Variant 95 must state assumptions, define a falsifiable hypothesis, name metrics, and include one failure or rollback condition.
source_assistant: An expert answer should distinguish model-domain mechanisms from runtime measurements. Required technical anchors: separate storage throughput from GPU DMA, validate filesystem and kernel support, measure queue depth and tail latency, compare CPU-staged I/O, and test restart consistency after interruption. It must report topology, workload, units, baselines, confounders, and evidence needed before claiming improvement.
corrected_answer: Begin fail-closed with an authorized, isolated copy and preserve the CPU-staged fallback. Diagnose storage saturation, filesystem or kernel incompatibility, queueing, NUMA placement, permissions, inactive direct DMA, corruption, and recovery separately before changing one reversible variable. The falsifiable hypothesis is that an independently evidenced active GDS path reduces end-to-end training I/O stall or host CPU at fixed work versus CPU staging without worsening throughput, p99 latency, errors, checksums, or interruption/node-loss recovery. Inventory GPU/storage/PCIe topology, NUMA and process/I/O affinity, filesystem, kernel, driver/runtime versions, permissions, format and durability semantics. Measure storage and GPU-DMA throughput separately in GB/s; end-to-end and stall time in ms; host CPU%, GPU idle%, queue depth, p50/p95/p99 latency, retries/errors, synchronized timestamps, checksum results, and recovery time. Run repeated paired cold/warm-cache and contention-controlled trials with sample counts and variance or confidence intervals. Require direct-path counters or equivalent independent evidence; quarantine outputs and roll back to CPU staging on prerequisite failure, missing activation evidence, checksum mismatch, unsafe recovery, or repeated pre-registered threshold breaches.
risks: platform-specific GDS support and direct GPU-DMA activation are unverified
storage, transport, cache, compression, and application effects may be confounded
interruption or node failure may reveal checkpoint integrity and recovery defects
evidence_required: matched CPU-staged and GDS trial logs with synchronized counters
throughput, latency, utilization, queue-depth, error, checksum, and recovery measurements
